children: CBB Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (OTCQX: CBBI), the parent company of Commonwealth Business Bank (the “Bank”), today announced the appointment of Jeffrey D. Green to its Board of Directors and the Board of Directors of the Bank. Mr. Green will also serve as Chair of the Board’s Audit Committee, effective October 1, 2026.

Mr. Green has more than 30 years of experience in public accounting, corporate governance, financial reporting, regulatory compliance, enterprise risk management, and financial services leadership. Most recently, he served as an independent director and Audit Committee Chair of HomeStreet, Inc., where he was designated as the Audit Committee Financial Expert. Prior to his board service, Mr. Green spent more than three decades at Moss Adams LLP, now Baker Tilly US, LLP, where he retired as a Partner after serving in several leadership roles, including Financial Institutions National Practice Leader and Everett Office Managing Partner.

“We are pleased to welcome Mr. Green to our Board,” said Soon Han Pak, Chair of both the Company and the Bank. “Mr. Green has earned a reputation as a trusted advisor, accomplished governance leader, and financial expert. His experience advising financial institutions and leading public company audit functions will be a tremendous asset to our Board and stockholders.”

With this appointment, the Company further strengthens its Board with deep financial expertise and governance experience that will support its long-term strategy and continued commitment to serving its customers, communities, and stockholders.

CBB Bancorp, Inc. is the holding company of Commonwealth Business Bank, a full-service commercial bank which specializes in small-to-medium-sized businesses and does business as “CBB Bank.” The Bank has twelve full-service banking offices in Los Angeles and Orange Counties in California, Dallas County in Texas, Honolulu in Hawaii, Bergen County in New Jersey, and Queens County in New York. The Bank also operates three SBA regional offices in Los Angeles, Dallas, and Bergen Counties, as well as loan production offices in California, Georgia, Texas, and Virginia.
